preconditions.description: The number of vertices n and the move restriction k satisfy 1 <= k < n <= 10^6.
The input provides exactly n-1 parent integers for vertices 2 through n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p <= n for p in parents)
preconditions.description: Each parent value is a valid vertex index between 1 and n.
The input represents a valid tree rooted at vertex 1.

postconditions.description: The output is a single integer representing the maximum number of distinct leaves visited, which must be at least 1 since the tree has at least one leaf.

The output integer equals the maximum number of distinct leaves reachable in a single valid sequence of moves starting from the root, adhering to the rules: moving down to any leaf in the current subtree, or moving up from a leaf to an ancestor within depth k.
